page.overview:
Who is Chuck Choke Cables?

"Chuck Cables hails from the midwest but somehow found himself in California covering the biggest race of the season! A live telecaster for twenty years with the Plainville Pavement Press, he recently made the jump to RSN (Racing Sports Network) and became one of the hottest not-so-mini van-cams on the news team!"

In the film, he is seen broadcasting the Piston Cup races with Nelson Blindspot at Motor Speedway of the South and Los Angeles International Speedway.
